verdicts.title: The optimal hypercontractive constants for $\mathbb{Z}_3$ and biased Bernoulli random variables
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We resolve a folklore problem of determining the optimal hypercontractive constants $r_{p,q}(\mathbb{Z}_3)$ for the cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}_3$ for all $1 < p < q < \infty$. verdicts.title: A Lower Bound for the Fourier Entropy of Boolean Functions on the Biased Hypercube
